descriptionChirho: Quantitative sense indicating a large number of persons or things.
Indicating large extent, degree, size, or duration of time (e.g., considerable distance, great commotion, long time).
Of persons who are qualified, deserving, or capable enough for a role or task.
Adequate or satisfactory in quantity or degree to meet a need.
Substantivized legal term (τὸ ἱκανόν) referring to a financial guarantee or bail posted before authorities.
